item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-31
item.description:
Our open-source research community has been buzzing with activity across multiple projects. Notably, the `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have seen updates, with `statcheck` receiving admin updates and `escicheck` synchronizing changes from the `escicheckapp` repository. Meanwhile, `docpluck` has made significant progress, with fixes implemented for various issues, including a corpus-wide fix and updates to documentation. The `coarse` project has also seen advancements, with the addition of a "Buy Me a Coffee" support button and security hardening for the release audit and workflows. Additionally, `regcheck` has addressed several bugs and issues, including updates to the demo page and fixes for card preview and ad blocker interference. These connections and progress highlight the collaborative spirit and dedication of our community to advancing open-source research tools.

18 commits across 3 active repositories this week.

item.title: oddpub: 1 commit today
item.description:
quest-bih/oddpub

The `main` branch was updated with a commit that added functionality to the ontogenerator, specifically for "nature das and cas detection". The commit message suggests that this update is focused on detecting certain types of chemical compounds. No other branches were worked on in this set of commits. This single commit is the entirety of the changes, and it focuses on enhancing the ontogenerator's capabilities. The ontogenerator now has the ability to detect "nature das and cas", which is presumably related to chemical structure identification. The work is limited to the `main` branch, with no other branches receiving updates in this set of commits.

item.title: coarse: 13 commits today
item.description:
Davidvandijcke/coarse

Work was done on the `dev`, `main`, `codex/fix-release-audit`, and `codex/release-v1.9.0` branches. On the `dev` and `main` branches, "Buy Me a Coffee funding links" were added to the documentation, and a "Buy Me a Coffee support button" was added for the web feature. The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch saw the release audit and workflows being hardened for security, as well as the preparation of version `v1.9.0`, and frontier models were refreshed with the addition of a deep literature search. The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch also merged changes from other branches, including `codex/sync-main-v1.9.0` and `feat/latest-models-deep-literature`, which addressed pre-pr rollout findings.
